metadata.description: This is the ONE gated registered-protocol pack file `src/verbs/coordination/group-thinking-pack.mjs` reads (hardcoded path, no pack-selection mechanism) -- it holds every explicit-selection-gated protocol, not only genuine group-thinking discussion protocols. Each member's `kind` below classifies which shape it is; `loadProtocolPack()` currently strips unrecognized member fields before returning (`id`/`version` only), so `kind` is a source-of-truth/documentation field for readers of this file, not yet surfaced by `fgos coordination pack list`.
